title: Start where ego is finally questioned
summary: This meets the defensive moment that still assumes the self is right. The line becomes medicine by asking where ego comes from and how it can actually leave.
takeaway: Question ego before you protect it.
lifeApplication: Before the rebuttal, the explanation, or the cold withdrawal, feel the heat in the face and ask the line plainly. Let diagnosis begin before self-protection takes over.

source.shortMeaning: Ego loosens when it is examined instead of instinctively defended.
source.lifeApplication: When defensiveness rises, ask where ego came from before speaking from it.

evidence.coreClaim: Ego loosens when it is examined instead of instinctively defended.
evidence.turn: Treat ego as illness and keep the Guru's medicine near.
